description: Did the AI do what the prompt asked? Give the prompt and the answer it got. Finds every rule in the prompt that can be checked by reading (length in words, characters, sentences or lines, how many items, a list, a table and its columns, JSON and its keys, sections, plain text, what to include, start or end with, sign off as, what to leave out, no introduction, the language and spelling, first person, plain words, asking first, marking what is missing) and says for each whether the answer kept or broke it, with where. Also lists numbers, names, links and quotes in the answer that the prompt never gave it, which is where made-up facts hide, and for each broken rule the line that makes it hold. Use it before an AI answer is used or sent, and to make a prompt more reliable.

answer.description: The answer the AI gave, exactly as it came.

prompt.description: The prompt that was sent, with any material pasted into it.
